business_rules: material_quantity_unit, price_basis_unit and package_unit are separate fields.
A package/container code never implies its content quantity.
linear_meter and m are physically convertible but remain distinct business labels where a seller explicitly uses running metres.
Composite rate units are not used as stock units or price-basis units unless explicitly allowed by a product contract.
Conversion requiring characteristics is only valid when all required source fields are present and positive.
Rounding to whole packages belongs to purchase preparation/Module 5, not to the reference unit dictionary.
No numeric consumption default is inherited from a material type without product source or technical evidence.
